0022600032.text: The Lakers (7-2, 1st in the Pacific, 2nd in the West) host the Trail Blazers (6-1, 1st in the Northwest, 1st in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with both teams on three-game winning streaks. Los Angeles trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 136-129 at home on October 27, and the Lakers lost the 2025-26 series 1-2. Adou Thiero is out for Los Angeles with knee inflammation, while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle).
